summary: Petrol is NT$32.7/L for 95 (31.2 for 92), held down by a temporary government and CPC programme absorbing NT$6-12/L, so a modern 125cc costs about NT$0.55-0.75/km in fuel (60-45 km/L). The official owner average of 24.7 km/L gives 1.32/km but covers all bikes. Plug-in home charging costs only about NT$0.05-0.2/km if tariffs hold; the December review may change them. Swap subscriptions are different. Gogoro pay-per-use is about NT$1/km plus a setup fee, and Gogoro's own release says it beats petrol only for riders paying over NT$1.5/km. Ionex charges NT$52/kWh above its allowance, about 1.7-2.0/km, and has raised prices in 2026. At 300-500 km a month a fixed fee costs more than petrol. MOTC data show electric owners spent about NT$10,500 a year versus 8,400 for petrol riders. The cheapest route to parity is a plug-in scooter charged at home, because you avoid the battery fee. Verify the CPC price and tariffs before publishing.

findings.valueText: 11-02..08: gov goods-tax cut 3.7 + CPC extra 7.9 = 11.6. 11-16..22: 3.7 + 2.3 = 6.0. Unsmoothed 95 about 38.7 for 11-16..22 (derived 32.7+6.0). Cumulative absorbed: about NT$31.86bn to 11-01 (CNA); about NT$35.36bn to 11-15 (KingAutos). Week from 2026-03-16 absorbed 9.5 (gasoline).

findings.verifierNote: CNA text and KingAutos text both opened; numbers match. 'Normal rule: 25-50% absorption above 30 NTD/L' was not re-verified. No end date for the war-time programme found; 2027 unknown and at risk. If support is withdrawn, petrol would rise about 6-12 NTD/L (about 18-35%).

findings.subject: MOTC 113年 owner-reported fuel efficiency, all gasoline motorcycles
findings.quote: 燃油機車燃油效率 23.5 公里/公升 24.7 公里/公升 ↑1.2 公里/公升

findings.quote: 最終決議電價「暫時凍漲」。審議會考量中東戰事導致國際燃料價格高漲，為避免引發國內物價波動，決定本次電價調整暫不決定，留待今年12月併入第3次電價審議會審議「輸配電費率」時再行討論
findings.verifierNote: Freeze and December deferral confirmed. Numeric details (3.7823, 12.83%, 71.1bn) could not be seen in the opened page; treat as UNVERIFIED. Home charging is cheap enough that a rise barely matters.

findings.subject: Home charging cost per km (derived)
findings.valueText: About 32 Wh/km (single) to 39 Wh/km (dual) at the battery, plus charger losses: 0.05-0.07 NTD/km at 1.68/kWh; 0.07-0.09 at 2.16; 0.10-0.13 at 3.03; 0.13-0.18 at 4.14
findings.verifierNote: Arithmetic rechecked (1/31.4 kWh/km x 1.68 = 0.053). Depends on the unverified tariff table and assumed losses. Only applies to plug-in charging; swap subscribers pay the operator's fee instead.

findings.subject: Gogoro 0月租 pay-per-Ah plan
findings.valueText: No monthly fee; 1.1 NTD/Ah (about 1 NTD/km two-battery, about 0.85 single); 24-month contract; one-off setup fee. Setup-fee amounts 9,000 (two-battery) / 6,000 (single) are NOT stated on the press release; only 'limited-time waivers' for 2025-07 promotions are.
findings.quote: 方案綁約 24 個月，無須繳交月租費，於開通時收取一次性的「設定費」，用來營運能源基礎建設。每月僅按實際騎乘用量收費，採每安時 $1.1 元的費率，折合每公里成本約 $1 元
findings.verifierNote: Rate, 24 months and setup-fee existence confirmed. The 9,000/6,000 setup-fee amounts were not on the page (reported only via Yahoo in the earlier pass, not rechecked): SECONDARY. Press release footnote itself says the plan (excluding setup fee) is cheaper only for the 40%+ of petrol riders paying over NT$1.5/km and 'comparable' to the 50% paying about NT$1/km.

findings.subject: Gogoro 0月租 per km including setup fee (derived)
findings.verifierNote: Arithmetic rechecked and correct GIVEN the unverified 9,000/6,000 setup fee. Without setup fee: 1.0 or 0.85 per km flat, which exceeds modern-125cc petrol at 45+ km/L (0.73).
